should_trigger: Update compatible dependency patches in the web workspace and verify them.
Inventory outdated pnpm packages before selecting a scoped upgrade.
Upgrade the Fastify package group while checking peer compatibility.
Prepare a new lock with lifecycle scripts disabled before auditing it.
Update only the requested Drizzle dependencies and review their changelogs.
should_trigger_test: Handle the Expo dependency group without forcing its React version onto web.
Stop and preserve evidence when a scoped dependency update fails verification.
should_not_trigger: Audit the pnpm lock dependency graph for supply-chain risks.
Record this reviewed exact package artifact in dependency-vet.json.
Diagnose this Postgres unique constraint failure in a Drizzle repository.
Watch this pull request for new review comments and check results.
Walk me through the reasoning behind this existing implementation plan.
